name: Soft parenthesis
rationale: Thicker rounded parentheses give the open lens brackets a friendlier silhouette while the eight-dot iris stays centered and clear.
tradeoff: The compact iris detail may still soften at 16 px.

name: Four soft corners
rationale: Splitting each bracket into upper and lower arcs adds breathing room around the same eight-dot iris and makes the gaze feel lighter.
tradeoff: The extra gaps weaken the eye outline at very small sizes.

name: Resting capsule
rationale: A flatter, rounder shell keeps the shallow eye compact while a low eight-dot iris preserves the resting gaze.
tradeoff: The capsule silhouette can read as a control without the iris.

name: Resting open lids
rationale: Separate shallow lid arcs leave the corners open and keep the lowered eight-dot iris visible in a calm, horizontal mark.
tradeoff: The open corners may close up visually at 16 px.

name: Paired pearls
rationale: Rounder paired eyes hold four iris dots and a small pupil each, splitting the eight-circle motif evenly across both sides.
tradeoff: The two pupils add detail to an already dense small mark.

name: Converging pair
rationale: A larger iris group in each rounded eye turns the paired gaze gently inward while preserving four company dots per side.
tradeoff: The shared inward direction can make the pair feel more intent than relaxed.
